name: Adult age-band denominator
numerator_or_summary: sum of declared ACS B01001 estimate cells
interval_or_uncertainty: approximate ACS 90 percent margin of error
availability_rule: unavailable when a required source estimate is unavailable
interpretation_limit: survey-derived area estimate with approximate margin that omits covariance

name: Synthetic planning-need event count
availability_rule: available only when the generated row and denominator reconcile
interpretation_limit: not a diagnosis observed case eligibility result outcome or allocation signal

name: Crude synthetic rate
availability_rule: unavailable when adult denominator is zero
interpretation_limit: age composition remains in the crude value

name: Standard age weight
numerator_or_summary: matched ACS adult population in age band
availability_rule: unavailable if the common standard is incomplete
interpretation_limit: one declared teaching standard rather than a risk or allocation standard

name: Directly standardized synthetic rate
numerator_or_summary: weighted sum of tract age-specific synthetic rates
interval_or_uncertainty: normal approximation from weighted binomial variance
availability_rule: unavailable when any tract age-band denominator is zero
interpretation_limit: relative teaching index rather than actual local risk or expected events

name: Expected synthetic events
numerator_or_summary: tract age denominator times statewide synthetic age-specific rate summed across age bands
interval_or_uncertainty: not presented as a real expected count
availability_rule: available when statewide synthetic rates and tract denominators are complete

name: Standardized event ratio
interval_or_uncertainty: log approximation with zero-count upper bound
availability_rule: unavailable when expected events are nonpositive
interpretation_limit: not comparable across tracts as a common-standard rate and not a real excess-case claim

name: PLACES modeled crude diabetes prevalence
interval_or_uncertainty: CDC published modeled 95 percent confidence interval
interpretation_limit: separate public modeled evidence and never an observed case count or synthetic numerator
